elements.quote: Previous studies have examined the diagnostic and prognostic performance of the aforementioned scoring systems in sepsis patients... However, pooled estimate of the proportion of positive scores, mortality rate, and predictive performance of these scores, by making use of meta-analysis in sepsis patients is lacking.
elements.reason: The Introduction describes current knowledge of DIC criteria in sepsis and explicitly identifies the uncertainty/gap (lack of pooled estimates).

elements.quote: This systematic review and metaanalysis assessed the proportion of DIC and coagulopathy in sepsis patients based on the ISTH-DIC, JAAM-DIC, and SIC criteria and evaluated their performance in predicting mortality in sepsis patients.
elements.reason: The importance and need for the review are explained by the identified gap and the stated aim of the review.

elements.quote: However, pooled estimate of the proportion of positive scores, mortality rate, and predictive performance of these scores, by making use of meta-analysis in sepsis patients is lacking.
elements.reason: The manuscript states that a pooled meta-analysis is lacking, indicating no similar prior systematic review is identified; no previous review is cited, so the conditional requirement does not apply.

elements.quote: A crosstalk between inflammation and coagulation [8], increased expression of tissue factor [9], suppression of fibrinolysis [10], and activation of platelets [10] are crucial mechanisms of DIC in sepsis.
elements.reason: The Introduction briefly describes the proposed mechanisms of DIC in sepsis, relevant to the intervention/exposure context of the review.

elements.quote: This systematic review and metaanalysis assessed the proportion of DIC and coagulopathy in sepsis patients based on the ISTH-DIC, JAAM-DIC, and SIC criteria and evaluated their performance in predicting mortality in sepsis patients.
elements.reason: This is a review of diagnostic/prognostic scoring system performance, not a review of complex interventions or delivery contexts, so a logic model is not required.

No retrieved evidence contains an explicit statement of the review's objective(s) or question(s) using a question-formulation framework. The evidence describes methods (PRISMA, PROSPERO registration, search strategy, eligibility criteria, outcomes) but never states the review objective or research question explicitly.
This is a review of diagnostic/prognostic score performance (DIC criteria in sepsis), not a review of intervention effects, so PICO-based planned comparisons do not apply.

elements.quote: Studies were included based on the following inclusion criteria: 1) studies involved sepsis patients; (2) observational studies; 3) studies that describe data about DIC diagnosis based on any of the three criteria (ISTH-DIC, JAAM-DIC, and SIC); 4) studies that reported the relationship between DIC diagnosis and at least one of the following outcomes: sensitivity or specificity or AUC to predict mortality.
elements.reason: Population (sepsis patients), study design (observational), index test criteria, and outcome/reporting requirements are all specified.

elements.quote: Studies were excluded if they were conference abstracts, case studies, reports of the same study, reviews...
elements.reason: Publication status is addressed (conference abstracts, case reports, reviews excluded), but no language or dissemination year restrictions are reported.

elements.quote: studies which did not report sensitivity, specificity, or data to calculate the score performance characteristics

elements.quote: Sixteen studies reported the performance of ISTH-DIC score involving 4466 patients; thirteen studies (3862 patients) reported the performance of JAAM-DIC score, and ten studies (4714 patients) reported the performance of SIC score.
elements.reason: Synthesis groups by DIC score are evident (plus subgroup analysis by region and sepsis stage per text_4), but the grouping is not explicitly linked to the review objectives/comparisons in the eligibility criteria section.
